SELECT substr(r_reason_desc,1,20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee) FROM web_sales 
JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 
JOIN (web_returns JOIN reason ON r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk) ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number 
JOIN web_page ON ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk 
JOIN (customer_demographics cd1 JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status) ON ws_order_number = wr_order_number 
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = COALESCE(wr_refunded_addr_sk, ws_bill_addr_sk) 
WHERE (cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'S', 'U') AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('Primary', 'College', 'Advanced Degree') AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 200.00) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 300)
GROUP BY substr(r_reason_desc,1,20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee) ORDER BY substr(r_reason_desc,1,20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee) LIMIT 100
